title: On Reading the letter twice before answering
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：read　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 read 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the teacher ① read the letter twice before answering year after year, and every pupil in the classroom said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the teacher ② reads the letter twice before answering for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ read the letter twice before answering at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ read the letter twice before answering before — a line in the notebook for March 1962 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Reading the letter twice before answering year after year, the teacher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ read as a warning rather than a threat for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Read as a warning rather than a threat at once and never mention it again.

By 1975 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new pupil from the next classroom ⑧ reads as a warning rather than a threat year after year every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the blackboard, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ read the letter twice before answering again when nobody else would.

⑩ To read the letter twice before answering, my mother said in 1980, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the classroom remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the classroom forgets, somebody reads the letter twice before answering for the whole place again and somebody must read the letter twice before answering year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 阅读（一般过去式 read the letter twice before answering：1968 年先生头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 阅读（一般现在 reads the letter twice before answering：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 阅读（不定式 to read the letter twice before answering：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 阅读（过去完成时 had read the letter twice before answering：1962 年三月的笔记簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 阅读（动名词 reading the letter twice before answering 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 读起来像（read as a warning rather than a threat：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去读起来像读来更像警告而不是威胁）
G. v. 读起来像（read as a warning rather than a threat：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 阅读（后段两处：新来的学童照例 reads as a warning rather than a threat，而母亲又一次 read the letter twice before answering）

answers.why: read 意为“阅读”，1968 年先生年年地阅读把那封信读了两遍才回，那是教室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 read。
read 意为“阅读”，自那以后先生替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 reads。
read 意为“阅读”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯阅读把那封信读了两遍才回”，此处为不定式 to read the letter twice before answering。
read 意为“阅读”，笔记簿里 三月 那行字说明早在 1975 年之前就有人阅读过，故用过去完成时 had read。
read 意为“阅读”，先生说“阅读把那封信读了两遍才回这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 reading the letter twice before answering 作主语。
read 意为“读起来像”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去读起来像读来更像警告而不是威胁”，should ever 之后用原形 read as a warning rather than a threat。
read 意为“读起来像”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻读起来像读来更像警告而不是威胁（read as a warning rather than a threat at once），以后再也不要提起。
read 意为“阅读”，新来的学童每个学期都照例读起来像读来更像警告而不是威胁，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 reads。
read 意为“阅读”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地阅读把那封信读了两遍才回，用一般过去式 read 叙述。
read 意为“阅读”，结尾那句是母亲 1980 年的话：要阅读把那封信读了两遍才回，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和教室记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年，先生年年地阅读把那封信读了两遍才回；教室里每一个学童都说这是头一回。（read the letter twice before answering）
多年以后，先生仍替所有人做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（reads the letter twice before answering）

先生说过，年年地阅读把那封信读了两遍才回这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（reading the letter twice before answering 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻读起来像读来更像警告而不是威胁，以后再也不要提起。（read as a warning rather than a threat，祈使句）
answers: In 1968 the teacher read the letter twice before answering year after year, and every pupil in the classroom said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three terms on, the teacher still reads the letter twice before answering for the whole place without being asked.
My mother said later that to read the letter twice before answering at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had read the letter twice before answering long before 1975, and the line in the notebook for March proves it.
Reading the letter twice before answering year after year, the teacher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Read as a warning rather than a threat at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 read 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1968 the teacher read the letter twice before answering year after year, and nobody in the classroom forgot it.
Even now the teacher reads the letter twice before answering for the whole place whenever the classroom asks.
Reading the letter twice before answering year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever read as a warning rather than a threat for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new pupil from the next classroom reads as a warning rather than a threat year after year every term, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother read the letter twice before answering again, and the classroom remembered that half.
